facility_nozzle_chemical_resistant_pp.structural_purpose: High-pressure solvent-proof industrial fluid sorting nozzle. Sliced at a dense 0.12mm layer height with a 100% solid concentric fill profile. Printing in chemical-resistant Polypropylene (PP) at 235C with zero active fan cooling completely fuses the toolpaths, producing an airtight, non-porous structure that is fully inert to ethanol and acidic terpene exposure.
